fusions.name: Hellhound's Bay
fusions.desc: Bays a ring of flame that deals 27 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Singeing Fang
fusions.desc: A bite with your weapon that deals 4 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Faithful Flame
fusions.desc: Sets a hound of flame on your enemies for 15 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it bites an enemy within 5 tiles, which deals 5 damage with a 25% chance to set the target [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hot on the Trail
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your damage rises by 12%.
